Used to lock the screen when you double tap, allowing you to use fingerprint to unlock. This service does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It only performs system-level actions like screen locking and taking screenshots when explicitly triggered by user gestures.

To provide a functional launcher experience, Launch processes information about your installed applications. All data is stored locally on your device and is never shared with third parties.

What we collect:
• Package names, app names, and icons
• Launch intent information

How we use it:
• Displaying and searching your apps
• Enabling app organization features
By clicking \'Accept\', you agree to these data practices.
To lock the screen and keep fingerprint unlock working, please enable Launch in Accessibility settings.

Allows the app to take pictures and record videos. This can be used for scanning QR codes, taking profile pictures, or making video calls.
